title: Add a CI boot smoke test for server.js

input.requestedOutcome: A CI job that would have caught S1-01: runs require('./server.js') for real (by spawning it) against a scratch Postgres, makes one authenticated /api/version request, and fails if map.*/db.* drift counters are non-zero or mig.failed/mig.pending is above zero.
acceptanceCriteria: New GitHub Actions workflow defines a Postgres service and boots server.js against it
Job fails if map.tables or map.columns is non-zero
Job fails if db.missing or db.extraInDb is non-zero
Job fails if mig.failed is non-zero or mig.pending > 0
constraints: Must not touch test/** or .github/workflows/tests.yml (owned by parallel task LAM-22)
No scratch Postgres available in this sandbox: DB-backed checks must be built into the CI workflow and reported as not_run/blocked locally, never passed
Stage only explicitly owned paths, no git add -A / git add .
assumptions: os-backend/ (deleted at 094dde1, the S1-01 bug) was already restored by 1c10d84 on this branch, so require('./server.js') succeeds today; this task adds the regression guard, it does not itself fix S1-01
db/migrations/ is documented as still absent from the repo (07-data-persistence-api.md sec 0), a separate, larger gap out of this task's scope
GitHub Actions runner provides Docker for the postgres service container (standard on ubuntu-latest)

output.summary: Added a GitHub Actions workflow (ci-boot-smoke.yml) with a scratch postgres:16 service that spawns server.js, logs in, and polls /api/version via a new tools/ci-boot-smoke.mjs script, failing the job if map.*/db.* drift counters are non-zero or mig.failed/mig.pending is above zero. Added a package.json convenience script. DB-backed verification could not be executed in this sandbox per task constraints (reported as not_run), so the job's real pass/fail behavior against Postgres, and its first execution on GitHub Actions, remain unverified locally; the job is also expected to fail red on this branch today because db/migrations/ is documented as absent (a separate, out-of-scope gap), which is flagged as a known risk and follow-up rather than worked around.

decisions: Used DATA_BACKEND=relational in the CI job (not the default blob) because db.*/mig.* drift checks only run meaningfully in that mode (server.js dbDriftCheck early-returns otherwise), matching how prod actually runs
Script performs a real login as a throwaway ADMIN_USER/ADMIN_PASS seeded by initDb() on first boot, since /api/version requires a session
Login is retried with a timeout rather than attempted once, because initDb() runs asynchronously after server.listen() fires and can race the first request
Readiness poll accepts any HTTP response as 'server is up' rather than grepping stdout for a specific log line, so the check does not rot if log wording changes
risks: This job is expected to fail red on this branch today, and that is the correct signal, not a bug in the check: db/migrations/ is documented as absent from the repo (07-data-persistence-api.md sec 0), which is out of this task's scope to restore. Without it, operation_schemas.* tables never get created in DATA_BACKEND=relational mode, so initDb()'s hand-written ALTER TABLE steps throw before the admin-seed step runs, meaning the smoke script's login will time out rather than reach a clean db.missing count
Branch protection to make this check required to merge is not configured by this diff; it is a GitHub repo setting with no file to edit for it
The workflow has not actually executed on GitHub Actions yet; the first real run may surface environment issues (image pull time, npm ci cache behavior) not visible locally
followUps: Restore db/migrations/ (or otherwise provision operation_schemas.* tables) so this job's db.*/mig.* counters are exercised meaningfully instead of failing at the login step
Configure ci-boot-smoke as a required status check under GitHub branch protection for refactor/booking-v2-migration
After the first real Actions run, confirm timing (image pull + npm ci + boot) comfortably fits the timeout-minutes: 10 budget; tune if needed
rollback: Delete .github/workflows/ci-boot-smoke.yml and tools/ci-boot-smoke.mjs, and remove the ci:boot-smoke line from package.json scripts. No data or schema changes to undo.
